regime_context: The regime is a staged, low-real-yield engineering campaign: the Fed is banking hawkish credibility now (Sept hike ~70% probability) while Treasury structurally suppresses front-end yields, with the administration holding easing as inflation-gated optionality post-midterm. The consensus narrative treats the hawkish tape as the end state; revealed interest says it is staging for a later pivot, and the Iran-triggered oil spike is now the main two-sided risk to that sequencing.
regime_context_zh: 当前体制是一场分阶段的低实际利率工程：美联储现在积累鹰派信誉（9月加息概率约70%），而财政部在结构上压低前端收益率，政府把宽松作为中期选举后受通胀门控的期权。市场共识把鹰派数据当作终局；但真实利益显示这只是为之后转向做的铺垫，伊朗引发的油价飙升目前是对这一节奏最大的双向风险。

theses.subject: XLE
theses.thesis: The Iran ceasefire collapse on 7/8 and Brent spiking toward $80 re-prime the energy rotation that already led Q1 2026 ETF inflows; the administration's 'strong dollar while cutting' bridge tolerates an oil-haven bid as long as it does not force premature Fed cuts.
theses.thesis_zh: 伊朗停火于7月8日破裂、布伦特原油飙升至80美元附近，重新点燃了能源板块的资金轮动（该板块在2026年一季度已是ETF流入首位）；政府'强势美元同时降息'的桥梁可以容忍油价避险买盘，只要它不迫使美联储过早降息。
evidence: Iran / Middle East theater: ceasefire COLLAPSED (as of 7/8), oil-spike realized (~$80 Brent intraday)
rotation_targeted: Energy (oil & gas) proxies XLE, XOP — basis FACT mechanism (headline-fragile)
recent track: XLE overweight hit, realized +0.1012, check_by 2026-10-06
theses.dissent: A rapid de-escalation or Hormuz transit normalization would collapse the geopolitical premium; energy is explicitly labeled headline-fragile.
theses.dissent_zh: 若局势快速降级或霍尔木兹海峡通行恢复正常，地缘政治溢价将迅速消退；能源板块被明确标注为对头条消息高度脆弱。

falsifier.text: XLE lags SPY by 5% or more over any rolling 10-day window before the check-by date
falsifier.text_zh: 在检查日之前，XLE在任何滚动10日窗口内跑输SPY达到5%或以上

theses.subject: GLD
theses.thesis: The Fed's hawkish staging (Sept hike >70% priced, real 10y at 2.29%, DXY firm) keeps real yields elevated, which is the primary headwind for gold despite the geopolitical bid; gold's $4,044–4,200 range reflects this tug-of-war, and the Fed's credibility banking favors the real-yield side.
theses.thesis_zh: 美联储的鹰派布局（9月加息概率超过70%、10年期实际利率2.29%、美元指数坚挺）使实际利率维持高位，这是黄金的主要逆风，尽管存在地缘政治买盘；金价在4044至4200美元区间波动反映了这场拉锯，而美联储积累信誉的动机更有利于实际利率这一侧。
evidence: Intelligence: CME FedWatch moved to >70% probability of a Sept hike; real 10y 2.29%; DXY ~100.9
Recent track: GLD underweight hit twice (realized +0.0163 and +0.0262)
Dollar / debt theater: low-real-yield regime is the administration's goal, but near-term Fed posture blocks gold upside
theses.dissent: A genuine Mar-a-Lago turn (low odds) or a sharp labor-crack forcing a dovish pivot would be dollar-bearish / gold-bullish and flip this lean.
theses.dissent_zh: 若真的出现'海湖庄园转向'（概率较低）或劳动力市场急剧恶化迫使美联储转鸽，将利空美元、利好黄金，并翻转这一判断。

falsifier.text: GLD closes above 4,200 for 5 consecutive sessions before the check-by date
falsifier.text_zh: 在检查日之前，GLD连续5个交易日收于4200美元上方

theses.subject: TLT
theses.thesis: The administration's yield suppression is explicitly targeted at the front end (bill-heavy issuance, buybacks, dealer reform), not the long end; with the Fed holding a hike-majority path and inflation running hot (core 3.4% y/y), the long end bears the stagflationary brunt and duration is the wrong place to fight the Fed.
theses.thesis_zh: 政府的收益率抑制明确针对前端（发行偏向短债、回购、交易商改革），而非长端；在美联储保持加息占多数路径、通胀高企（核心同比3.4%）的情况下，长端承受滞胀冲击，久期资产不是与美联储对赌的正确位置。
evidence: Inflation data: May PCE core +0.3% m/m, 3.4% y/y (highest since Oct-2023)
Fed path gap: market ≈ the Fed, end-2026 dot 4.1% vs market 4.01%
Recent track: TLT underweight hit, realized -0.0719, check_by 2026-09-29
theses.dissent: If the labor crack widens (June payrolls +57k, participation 61.5%) and forces a September dovish pivot, long-duration Treasuries would rally sharply on the front-running of rate cuts.
theses.dissent_zh: 若劳动力市场裂缝扩大（6月非农仅增5.7万、劳动参与率61.5%）并迫使美联储在9月转鸽，长端美债将因市场抢跑降息而大幅上涨。

falsifier.text: TLT outperforms SPY by 3% or more over the horizon before the check-by date
falsifier.text_zh: 在检查日之前，TLT在考察期内跑赢SPY达到3%或以上

theses.subject: SMH
theses.thesis: The 25% advanced-chip tariff stays in force and the Section 301 replacement (~12.5%) is pending, keeping the onshoring tariff premium intact for domestic fabs; the de-risking mandate funds chip onshoring regardless of any China truce, and the SCOTUS strike-down did not unwind the tariff-protection bid.
theses.thesis_zh: 25%的先进芯片关税仍然有效，301条款替代方案（约12.5%）悬而未决，使本土晶圆厂的关税保护溢价得以维持；无论中美是否达成休战，去风险化指令都会资助芯片本土化，最高法院的否决也没有解除关税保护带来的买盘。
evidence: China tech war theater: onshoring bid persists contingent on Section 301 handoff completing cleanly
rotation_targeted: Domestic semiconductors / fabs proxies SMH, SOXX
Recent track: SMH overweight hit, realized +0.0138, check_by 2026-10-02
theses.dissent: A full China trade normalization that removes the Section 301 tariff would strip the onshoring premium; SOXX/SMH have high sensitivity to global tech capex cycles.
theses.dissent_zh: 若中美贸易全面正常化并取消301条款关税，将剥离本土化溢价；SOXX和SMH对全球科技资本开支周期高度敏感。

falsifier.text: SMH lags SPY by 5% or more over the horizon before the check-by date
falsifier.text_zh: 在检查日之前，SMH在考察期内跑输SPY达到5%或以上

theses.subject: KBE
theses.thesis: The dealer-bank re-intermediation theme is real but the timing is unproven: concrete eSLR reform and Treasury central-clearing expansion remain pending (no proposed or final rule yet), and the last KBE overweight missed (-0.0818). Small-sample discipline says avoid until a regulatory milestone lands.
theses.thesis_zh: 交易商银行再中介化的主题是真实的，但时机未得到验证：具体的eSLR改革和财政部中央清算扩展仍悬而未决（尚未有拟议或最终规则），且上一次KBE超配判断失误（-0.0818）。小样本纪律要求在有监管里程碑落地之前回避。
evidence: Open predictions: Concrete eSLR-reform progress (a proposed or final rule) — still pending
Open predictions: SEC advances Treasury central-clearing expansion — still pending
Recent track: KBE overweight miss, realized -0.0818, check_by 2026-10-02
theses.dissent: If a concrete eSLR relief or central-clearing rule drops, dealer banks would re-rate quickly and the avoid call would lag the move.
theses.dissent_zh: 若出现具体的eSLR放松或中央清算规则，交易商银行将迅速重估，回避判断将落后于行情。

falsifier.text: KBE outperforms SPY by 5% or more before any eSLR or central-clearing rule is announced
falsifier.text_zh: 在eSLR或中央清算规则公布之前，KBE跑赢SPY达到5%或以上
